title: How earnings work
summary: From a closed deal to money in your bank.
body: A closed deal is not yet payable. POBO first receives the fee, Finance reconciles it with the bank, then your commission becomes eligible, is approved, goes into the monthly payout batch and is paid with a bank UTR. Each item in Earnings says what it is waiting for. Amounts marked Estimate use an interim rule, not final policy.

title: Mapping, survey and listing are different
summary: Keep each record for what it is.
body: Mapping adds towers, floors and flats. A survey records who lives there and their intent. A listing is a flat ready to market, and only a supervisor-verified listing is shown to buyers.

title: Welcome to POBO
summary: How your day works in the app.
body: Go On Duty when you start. Home shows what needs you now: new leads with an SLA timer, follow-ups due, visits today and territory floats. Work top to bottom. Go Off Duty when you finish.

title: Calling a new lead within 15 minutes
summary: Why the first call matters and what counts.
body: Every new lead has a 15-minute target and a 30-minute breach during service hours (09:00 to 18:00). Any logged call outcome counts as first contact. If the customer asks not to be called, choose Do not contact: calls, messages and follow-ups are then blocked.

title: Do not contact (DNC)
body: When a customer is marked DNC the app blocks outbound calls, messages and follow-ups. Only Ops can lift DNC, with a reason, if the customer asks to be contacted again.
